ms.promise:
・Implement enhanced transaction handling features by using improved APIs like Blockfrost and robust servers to reduce failures and improve transaction speed.

ms.criteria:
・Achieve a transaction failure rate of less than 5%.
・Transaction building times should not exceed 3 seconds for 95% of transactions under normal conditions.
・Real time alerts for Markets Creation & Resolution on Discord and Slack functioning as intended
ms.report:
Milestone 2 Proof Of Achievement Satisfies the "Outputs", the "Acceptance Criteria" and the "Evidence of Milestone Completion"
Milestone Output
We Implemented enhanced transaction handling features by using Paid Blockfrost APIs and also hosted On AWS servers to reduce failures and improve transaction speed.
We also set up a comprehensive real time alerts on Discord and Slack to report, log and monitor events like Market Creation & Resolution to facilitate easier troubleshooting and optimization of the platform.

Acceptance criteria
Transaction submitting on Foreon Network has a transaction failure rate of less than 5%.
Also we optimized the transaction building times not to exceed 3 seconds for over 95% of transactions under normal conditions, unless the Cardano network is under heavy load.
We have also set up Real time alerts for Markets Creation & Resolution on Discord and Slack functioning as intended
